native.0013502064d918ab:
Aligns infill, bridge, ironing, and top/bottom surface directions to follow the model's orientation on the build plate.
When enabled, these directions rotate together with the model so the printed features keep their intended orientation relative to the part, preserving optimal strength and surface characteristics regardless of how the model is placed.
native.01d242c2695fa8f1: Generate interlocking beam structure at the locations where different filaments touch. This improves the adhesion between filaments, especially models printed in different materials.
native.025431a245634ba5: Enable this to get a commented G-code file, with each line explained by a descriptive text. If you print from SD card, the additional weight of the file could make your firmware slow down.
native.02a5927418e969d7: Branch tip diameter for organic supports.
native.048bb8a827ef924c: This is the speed for support.
native.059c4fde4b7489ed: This is the number of solid layers of top shell, including the top surface layer. When the thickness calculated by this value is thinner than the top shell thickness, the top shell layers will be increased
native.05cabd3df24eb5b4: This setting only generates supports that begin on the build plate.
native.0623188df74befba: This option will drop the temperature of the inactive extruders to prevent oozing.
native.068f9d5f1fa19f48:
Maximum defection of a point to the estimated radius of the circle.
As cylinders are often exported as triangles of varying size, points may not be on the circle circumference. This setting allows you some leeway to broaden the detection.
In mm or in % of the radius.
native.071f8b8353f880ad: Change flow ratios for other extrusion path types.
native.08ba9a12aeaf2806: Purging after filament change will be done inside objects\' support. This may lower the amount of waste and decrease the print time. It will not take effect unless a prime tower is enabled.
native.0969bf5607dd264b:
This factor affects the amount of material for the support interface.

The actual support interface flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
native.097196e95d83d4f8: Holes in objects will expand or contract in the XY plane by the set value. Positive values make holes bigger and negative values make holes smaller. This function is used to adjust sizes slightly when objects have assembly issues.
native.09b9b6592e73d507: This is the speed for support interfaces.
native.0a8fd6cb54ca64f0: Klipper's max_accel_to_decel will be adjusted to this %% of acceleration.
native.0a99f6c6af7b4278: Rib width is always less than half the prime tower side length.
native.0b16d104fdb0de5c: Number of skirt layers: usually only one
native.0ba6533d51472ae3: Disable alternating fill direction when using Z contouring.
native.0c1c61eb20fa7b03: This is the acceleration of top surface infill. Using a lower value may improve top surface quality.
native.0caa1a36b94ff6eb: Only one wall on top surfaces
native.0cc9cfd12555db9a: Enabling this option means the width of the brim for tree support will be automatically calculated.
native.0d80aa6d9fa5107a: Limits the skirt/draft shield loops to one wall after the first layer. This is useful, on occasion, to conserve filament but may cause the draft shield/skirt to warp / crack.
native.0dd1b74b50e095b5: This controls the generation of the brim at outer and/or inner side of models. Auto means the brim width is analyzed and calculated automatically.
native.10e1c1849fcbe4d9: This is the speed for the first layer except for solid infill sections.
native.112ae1ae6e012a60: Wipe tower rotation angle with respect to X axis.
native.1454d3b215b8f741: Force the generation of solid shells between adjacent materials/volumes. Useful for multi-extruder prints with translucent materials or manual soluble support material.
native.1708cfb786da0239: The number of octaves of coherent noise to use. Higher values increase the detail of the noise, but also increase computation time.
native.1789d3b5e7ac3c67:
Fixed angle for the top solid infill and ironing lines.
Set to -1 to follow the default solid infill direction.
native.17b984d7a45da2f4: This parameter adds a slight displacement to each layer of infill to create a cross texture.
native.17cf8088d3c4fc62: Angle from the object center to skirt start point. Zero is the most right position, counter clockwise is positive angle.
native.17ef47ed752cfbf5: This is the speed for internal sparse infill.
native.18974d68ac50a6d9: This detects thin walls which can\u2019t contain two lines and uses a single line to print. It may not print as well because it\u2019s not a closed loop.
native.18af5e674cb1973b:
Filament to print support interface.
"Default" means no specific filament for support interface and current filament is used.
native.1aabbeabb9ea6ed6: Print order within a single layer.
native.1b67eafb329af5f2:
The geometry will be decimated before detecting sharp angles. This parameter indicates the minimum length of the deviation for the decimation.
0 to deactivate.
native.1be24cae2db5b551: The minimum wall width that should be used for the first layer is recommended to be set to the same size as the nozzle. This adjustment is expected to enhance adhesion.
native.1c7932198dc758a4: Support layer uses layer height independent with object layer. This is to support customizing Z-gap and save print time. This option will be invalid when the prime tower is enabled.
native.1d453d680427f476: Contours of objects will expand or contract in the XY plane by the set value. Positive values make contours bigger and negative values make contours smaller. This function is used to adjust sizes slightly when objects have assembly issues.
native.1fb5d835437da543: Applies extrusion rate smoothing only on external perimeters and overhangs. This can help reduce artefacts due to sharp speed transitions on externally visible overhangs without impacting the print speed of features that will not be visible to the user.
native.1fd19c3957730e76: Z gap between the object and the support bottom. If Support Top Z Distance is 0 and the bottom has interface layers, this value is ignored and the support is printed in direct contact with the object (no gap).
native.202392dea385c207: Travel speed of the first layer.
native.21372a8c8027904a:
If enabled, internal bridge extrusion uses a line height equal to the nozzle diameter.
This increases internal bridge strength and reliability when printed over sparse infill, but may worsen appearance.
If disabled, internal bridges may look better but can be less reliable over sparse infill.
native.226344c4782282e5: Ironing uses a small flow to print at the same height of a surface to make flat surfaces smoother. This setting controls which layers are being ironed.
native.230dbe0bda7b5cdf: Brim width of prime tower, negative number means auto calculated width based on the height of prime tower.
native.2334e5e76652eed8: This sets the threshold for small support perimeter length. The default threshold is 0mm.
native.23bba727b6011024: Maximum straightening angle used to simplify Lightning branches.
native.25ac2164bc3a115c: Sets the finishing flow ratio while ending the spiral. Normally the spiral transition scales the flow ratio from 100% to 0% during the last loop which can in some cases lead to under extrusion at the end of the spiral.
native.25f78653ccbfa47e: This setting specifies the count of support walls in the range of [0,2]. 0 means auto.
native.26dd0d20b5b03938: The number of bottom solid layers is increased when slicing if the thickness calculated by bottom shell layers is thinner than this value. This can avoid having too thin a shell when layer height is small. 0 means that this setting is disabled and the thickness of the bottom shell is determined simply by the number of bottom shell layers.
native.28ee2645f58aa88b: The parameter sets the overlapping depth between the interior and skin.
native.2ba48ba2c97c3124:
This option creates bridges for counterbore holes, allowing them to be printed without support. Available modes include:
1. None: No bridge is created
2. Partially Bridged: Only a part of the unsupported area will be bridged
3. Sacrificial Layer: A full sacrificial bridge layer is created
native.2c121e2c08a25fb4: This setting determines the maximum overhang angle that the branches of tree support are allowed to make. If the angle is increased, the branches can be printed more horizontally, allowing them to reach farther.
native.2c40fa18822a2332: This expands the first raft or support layer to improve bed adhesion.
native.2cc1571e83e3389c: Minimum number of segments of each scarf.
native.2face90be0ac0766: This separate setting will affect the speed of perimeters having radius <= small_perimeter_threshold (usually holes). If expressed as percentage (for example: 80%) it will be calculated on the outer wall speed setting above. Set to zero for auto.
native.30352d28bc280706:
When enabled, the brim is aligned with the first-layer perimeter geometry after Elephant Foot Compensation is applied.
This option is intended for cases where Elephant Foot Compensation significantly alters the first-layer footprint.

If your current setup already works well, enabling it may be unnecessary and can cause the brim to fuse with upper layers.
